## Context
Gerrit Verify currently runs thousands of repeated real Pandoc subprocess conversions over the complete DC wiki corpus. Run 31798375024 attributed at least 184.32 seconds of the macOS critical path to two visible corpus phases alone. The operator confirmed the architecture research and approved moving the complete real-Pandoc corpus replay to the External Integration Tests workflow. Current ADR 0095 explicitly requires every conversion assertion to use the real binary, so this testing-boundary change requires a narrow superseding ADR before implementation.

## Research decision
Popular maintained OSS precedent supports committed golden/static outputs plus compact live boundary probes: Pandoc uses literal writer outputs; nbconvert and pypandoc use small real-Pandoc probes; Kubernetes client-go commits golden request/response fixtures; Rust compiletest uses blessed output snapshots. The approved design keeps three representative live corpus bodies (code_arrow, table, prose) plus existing compact provenance probes in Gerrit Verify. It preserves every assertion class against committed outputs in Verify. It moves complete real-Pandoc replay to a dedicated weekly/manual Pandoc job inside .github/workflows/external-integration.yml.

The current External Integration workflow has four Ubuntu-only jobs and no macOS runner. The later implementation ticket must therefore add an explicit pandoc-corpus-replay job whose matrix is os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]; this is planned future implementation scope, not a claim about current workflow state and not part of this documentation-only ADR change. The job will run the complete replay on both platforms. Version drift and platform-specific binary fingerprints fail fast. Deterministic regeneration remains available. The 184.32-second figure is a lower-bound estimate; implementation must obtain paired A/B evidence.

## Plan
- Add a numbered ADR in docs/adr that narrowly supersedes ADR 0095 only where it mandates a real Pandoc process for every conversion assertion.
- Preserve the production segmenting renderer, pin/provenance, Linux/macOS platform boundary, fallback behavior, and every safety/fixed-point/richness assertion class.
- Amend ADR 0095 with a clear Superseded-by notice scoped to the testing-assurance clause.
- Update docs/architecture.md with the authoritative hot-path versus external-integration verification boundary.
- Record that the later implementation adds a dedicated pandoc-corpus-replay matrix to the currently Ubuntu-only external-integration workflow.
- Regenerate the ADR index and number markers using scripts/gen_adr_index.py.
- Run ADR numbering/index guards, documentation/link checks, lint, and the repository commit-ticket verifier.
- Submit this documentation-only decision through Gerrit. Do not begin implementation until this ADR is merged after HOLD approval.

## Expected file impact
- docs/adr/0095-dc-segmenting-wiki-renderer.md
- docs/adr/0096-pandoc-corpus-verification-boundary.md
- docs/adr/README.md
- docs/adr/.numbers/0096
- docs/architecture.md

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The ADR cites the confirmed dependency research and named OSS precedents.
- [ ] The ADR narrows supersession to the test execution boundary.
- [ ] The ADR preserves every production renderer invariant.
- [ ] Gerrit Verify retains three representative live corpus contracts plus the compact pin/provenance probes.
- [ ] Every existing assertion class remains required against committed deterministic outputs in Gerrit Verify.
- [ ] The ADR states that external-integration.yml is currently Ubuntu-only.
- [ ] The ADR assigns future implementation of a dedicated pandoc-corpus-replay matrix with ubuntu-latest and macos-latest arms.
- [ ] Complete real-Pandoc corpus replay is assigned to that weekly/manual external-integration job.
- [ ] Installed Pandoc version drift fails fast.
- [ ] Each supported platform binary fingerprint is verified.
- [ ] Deterministic fixture regeneration remains documented.
- [ ] The ADR states that 184.32 seconds is a one-run lower bound.
- [ ] The ADR requires paired A/B implementation evidence.
- [ ] ADR 0095 points to the superseding decision.
- [ ] docs/architecture.md documents the verification boundary.
- [ ] ADR number/index guards pass.
- [ ] Documentation link guards pass.
- [ ] No implementation code is included in this ADR change.
- [ ] No test-routing change is included in this ADR change.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The ADR reaches HOLD in Gerrit; evidence is the Gerrit change id and HOLD announcement recorded on this ticket.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The ADR merges only after explicit approval; evidence is the approval identity and merge timestamp recorded on this ticket.
